        Rectangle(plate_length, plate_width)

    solid_body = solid_body - Pos(x, y, plate_thickness - cbore_depth / 2) * Cylinder(cbore_outer_radius, cbore_depth)

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
solid_body = offset(solid_body, amount=-wall_thickness, openings=[top_face])

top_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.Z)[-1]
top_edges = top_face.edges()
solid_body = chamfer(top_edges, chamfer_distance)

for i in range(slot_count):
    angle = i * 360.0 / slot_count
    slot = Rot(0, 0, angle) * Pos(outer_radius - wall_thickness / 2.0, 0, 0) * Box(wall_thickness + 0.2, slot_width, slot_height)
    solid_body = solid_body - slot

part = solid_body
part.name = "hollow_cylinder_with_slots"
